known.via: English Wikipedia "Moscato d'Asti" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: A Piedmont DOCG for sweet, low alcohol sparkling white wine made from Moscato Bianco, mainly in the province of Asti. It is considered a dessert wine and has a musky aroma. Asti is a related wine from the same grape and area.
